parsed.rationale: Both `WXYCBackground.wxycBackgroundDark` (BackgroundGradient.swift:30) and `WXYCGradient.wxycBackgroundDark` (WXYCGradient.swift:31) are exact-duplicate computed properties living in the same package (WXUI). Because the implementations are identical and neither record carries any test, codegen, mock, or sample-app flag, the duplication is unintentional. The cleanest Swift resolution is to extract the shared computed property into a single location — either a protocol with a default implementation or a free extension on a shared type — within the WXUI package, then remove the duplicate definitions from both files.
